identificationModule.briefTitle: A Multicenter Randomized Controlled Study on the Treatment of Refractory CTIT With Romiplostim N01 Compared to Recombinant Human Thrombopoietin
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter Randomized Controlled Study on the Treatment of Refractory CTIT With Romiplostim N01 Compared to Recombinant Human Thrombopoietin

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A Multicenter Randomized Controlled Study on the Treatment of Refractory CTIT With Romiplostim N01 Compared to Recombinant Human Thrombopoietin

interventions.name: Romiplostim N01
interventions.description: 2.0 µg/kg, subcutaneous injection, once a week, up to a maximum of 8 weeks. Stop medication when platelet count increases by 50 × 109/L or more compared to before medication

interventions.name: Recombinant Human Thrombopoietin
interventions.description: 30000 U/d, subcutaneously injected once a day, for a maximum of 8 weeks. Medication should be stopped when platelets increase by 50 × 109/L or more compared to before medication

primaryOutcomes.measure: The proportion of patients with PLT ≥ 50 × 109/L within 4 weeks after receiving treatment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The time required for PLT to recover to 50 × 109/L or above after treatment
The proportion of patients with PLT ≥ 50 × 109/L after 2 weeks of treatment
The proportion of patients with PLT ≥ 50 × 109/L after 12 weeks of treatment
The lowest platelet count from receiving treatment to the end of treatment
The proportion of patients receiving platelet transfusion
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 5 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The proportion of restoring anti-tumor treatment for at least 2 cycles without recurrence of CTIT
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 5 months
